items.text: Minnesota QB: Kirk Cousins has started Wks 10-11 and is expected to start; Kyler Murray (hamstring) targeting a Week 12 return but reportedly QB2 when healthy. Watch Wednesday practice.

Minnesota (early week): WR Jordan Addison (thumb surgery) not expected to play; LT Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) may miss (Ryan Van Demark would start); CB Isaiah Rodgers (quad) inactive Wk11; TE Josh Oliver injured.
Atlanta (off bye): Week 12 depth chart lists Michael Penix Jr. QB1, Tua Tagovailoa QB2. No new injuries noted; RB Brian Robinson Jr. on IR.
